description: This PHP class 'ProfilerListener' implements event handling for Symfony kernel events, adding profiling and modifying response content for debugging purposes within the Goteo project.

classes.name: ProfilerListener
classes.description: Event listener for Symfony kernel events that adds profiling, manages redirections, and injects debugging scripts into HTML responses.

methods.name: onKernelRequest
methods.description: Handles kernel request event, adds event to debug profiler.

methods.name: onKernelController
methods.description: Handles kernel controller event, adds event to debug profiler.

methods.name: onKernelResponse
methods.description: Handles kernel response event, adds profiling info, manages redirections, and injects debugging scripts into HTML content.

methods.name: onKernelTerminate
methods.description: Placeholder for handling kernel termination event.

methods.name: onKernelException
methods.description: Placeholder for handling kernel exception event.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns array of subscribed kernel events with their handler methods and priorities.
